fusions.name: Drawstring Throw
fusions.desc: Casts a mesh of strands over every enemy within 3.5 tiles, dealing 12 damage and stunning each for 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Hauled Weft
fusions.desc: Casts a strand at the first enemy it meets for 7 damage, then on to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles, each taking 60% of that. Holds 4 charges; kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Picket Weave
fusions.desc: Raises a wall of woven strands 6 tiles long for 8 seconds. Nothing crosses it.

fusions.name: Snagging Loops
fusions.desc: Every time you hit an enemy, a stack builds on it, up to 5. When you reach 5, they all spend at once: a blow strikes that enemy for 34% of your weapon damage per stack (170% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 4 seconds.
